proof_summary: Three iterations of run-length encoding expose an eventual four-step self-similarity, yielding statistics satisfying \(k_{n+1}=k_n+q_n\), \(q_{n+1}=q_n+p_n\), and \(p_{n+5}=p_{n+4}+k_n\), while row lengths and row sums are successive partial sums of the run counts. For the root \(\rho\in(1,2)\) of \(\rho^4(\rho-1)^3=1\), a positive left-eigenvector potential scales exactly by \(\rho\); comparison and geometric-sum bounds then show the relevant statistics are \(\Theta(\rho^n)\), so their \(n\)-th roots tend to \(\rho\).
